text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Happy New Year. Today, I went for the first shrine visit of the year
with Matikanefukukitaru...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Or at least, that was the plan,
but they didn't show up, so I came alone.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, Trainer-dono.
I shall grant thee thy wish~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Today I feel like putting on the airs of a god. For I am
a child blessed by good fortune. Nyohohoho...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Ever since running well in the Kikuka Sho,
Matikanefukukitaru gets carried away from time to time."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps spurred by the celebratory New Year's mood,
their bad habit seems especially prominent today.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And so, what is it that thou desirest?
Speak freely, as thy heart wills.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: My wish is—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, wishing to offer yakiniku, are you? A fine mindset.
Then let us make haste...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! Getting treated to yakiniku right at the start of the new year is such good luck~.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer, that one over there is cooked!
Say your thanks and dig in.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a result of treating her to yakiniku, Matikanefukukitaru's
stamina increased. Could this be a divine blessing?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, wishing for an overall boost, are you?
Then let us head over yonder.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Now then, karaoke time! First blast of the new year,
let's get super hyped, totally hyped!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look, a new song's out.
"False Bottom Pudding" by Up Up Horse.
Let's give this one a shot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As a result of singing with maximum hype, Matikane
Fukukitaru's athletic abilities improved across the board.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, wishing for skill improvement, are you?
Then let us make haste to that place.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "Let's do a shrine maiden dance right here! It's the New Year, and I've always wanted to try one."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like trying a different dance once in a while
would be a good learning experience, too."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Haaah, Takasago-ya~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is this... a shrine maiden dance?
Still, her range of movement seems to have expanded.
